title: Daily Match Pop
description: Pop glossy candies and colorful blocks in snappy match-3 rounds—unleash rainbow cascades and rack up huge combo multipliers across relaxing stages.
controls: Swap adjacent tiles to align three or more of the same color and clear every level objective.

zh-CN.title: 天天消一消
zh-CN.description: 经典全民解压三消天天消一消：指尖轻划触发全屏彩虹连锁爆破，音效清脆手感丝滑，随时来一局根本停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动交换相邻方块凑齐三个及以上同色消除，合成特效道具轻松通关。
